versions.changelog:
- Initial release of the identity-primitive-chain skill.
- Supports automatic task complexity assessment and adapts execution: simple tasks use adaptive identity primitives, complex tasks are decomposed into primitive chains.
- Offers 7 domains covering 35 execution tasks, organized by workflow.
- Default hides execution details (input/process/output), but provides them on user request.
- Includes a structured 3-layer reference system for catalog, methodologies, and exemplars.
- Implements strict fact discipline: only verified information is used; complexity assessments and reasoning are transparent to users.
